seed._comment: Amazon_Rates_Test_Input - real seed rows, read live from mabl

filter._comment: vin MUST be in unique_on - without it, every seed row collapses to one set of rate options

trigger._comment: Targets ONLY the 'SGPOC | Pipeline verification' plan (label SGPOC_Pipeline), which holds our demo copies of the tests. This deliberately excludes the Safe-Guard team's own Amazon plans so the pipeline never triggers their work.

mock._comment: Stands in for the real getRates call and the Salesforce/PG lookups. Swap sources.py for live HTTP when a self-hosted runner exists. duplicate_options simulates the repeated rate options a real response returns, so the dedupe stage has something to do.
